title: Range Frequency Queries
description: Store the indices of each number in a sorted dictionary and use binary search to count occurrences within [left, right].

steps.note: Initializing map with indices of elements in arr [1, 1, 2, 1, 2]
Binary search finds first index >= 0 in [2, 4] which is index 0
Binary search finds first index > 4 in [2, 4] which is index 2
